message.content:
A medium-sized tomato (about 123 g) contains roughly **22 kcal**.  
The calorie count varies with size and variety:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~80 | ~15 kcal |
| Medium | ~123 | ~22 kcal |
| Large | ~182 | ~33 kcal |

These figures are averages; actual values can differ slightly depending on ripeness and cultivar.
